title: What does First Katalyst do?
desc: When you work at First Katalyst, you get to be part of a team that is known for its performance. We are efficiency-driven professionals who focus on the endgame.

title: What industries do you specialize in?
desc: First Katalyst focuses not just on recruiting individuals that are performance oriented but also on developing them. To us it is important to ensure that our clients are satisfied and are being served with the care and respect they deserve.

title: What services does First Katalyst offer?
desc: From our profile: Experiential; Activations; Sales and Distribution; Merchandising Management; Field Force Management; Procurement and Production; and Creative Development.

title: What is included under Experiential?
desc: Trade and Consumer Events; In-Bar consumer engagement; In-Club experience; Neighborhood drive; In-Store Consumer activation; Consumer Sampling; Key account sampling and engagement; Concerts/Premiers; Media, Trade, Consumer launch.

title: What is included under Activations?
desc: Market storm; Sampling; Wholesale drive; Market sitters; Neighborhood storm; Campus storm.

title: What is Sales and Distribution and Merchandising Management?
desc: Sales and Distribution covers retail penetration drive, wholesale/retail engagement, trade expansion scheme, rural market expansion, open market launch, hawkers forum, and wholesale canvassers scheme. Merchandising Management covers Merchandisers to Ambassadors, packaging/price change communication, merchandising toolkit/POSM production and deployment, and gondola manufacturing and deployment.
